metadata.description:
This data set provides the raw EXAFS and XRD data of the manuscript 'Atomic-scale environment of niobium in minerals as revealed by X-ray absorption spectroscopy at the Nb K-edge' submitted to European Journal of Mineralogy.

- EXAFS data files were converted into .txt for more accessibility. Pcl is the abbreviation for pyrochlore. The files are accoridngly labelled.

- XRD data files for synthetic Nb-doped compounds start with 'XRD_...'.

- The refined crystal structure of hydropyrochlore is 'hydropcl_01.cif' file.
